population_scope: This source replay deliberately reuses the previously exposed 64 stochastic ecological visitor RNG history IDs. It is a post-outcome mechanistic probe, not a new 64 independent history validation.
Genome transplant effects are conditioned on source both-alive at t20, 50/64, and one eight-individual whole-genome resample per source history.

All genomic loci matching/investment/assurance and covariance are transplanted together; higher assurance allele source mean selected versus neutral (+0.08267) does not establish assurance locus-specific causality.
FWER intervals are a retrospective source-method sensitivity on the same data, not a preregistered independent primary or an evolutionary-suicide effect.
Future capacity compares N0=8 in both K arms and fixed B=48, but is not a real-island area experiment.
